summary: Jeffrey — Rene's local vision+reasoning assistant (5060 Ti 16GB, Win11). See screen, think about Blender/CAD/holster work. Integrate Hey Clicky Windows + YURI offline spine.

subtasks.prompt: Decode Jeffrey requirements for CGSSCHWEIZ/Rene: RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, i7-14700K, Windows 11, branch rene. Jeffrey must see (screenshots, Blender viewport, STL refs, PDFs) and reason (holster blocking workflow, CAD steps). Prefer 100% local Ollama. Hey Clicky Windows port for screen-aware voice UI. YURI xref/search for repo knowledge. Output: acceptance criteria + hardware budget table.

Scout HF/GitHub for 2026 OSS VLMs + Fable-5 distillations fitting 16GB VRAM. Shortlist Qwen3-VL-8B, Gemma4 12B/E4B, Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B, MiniCPM-V-4.6-Thinking, Fable distill under 16GB. Output: ranked model matrix with Ollama tags + VRAM + vision+reasoning scores.

Design Jeffrey stack: (1) Hey Clicky Windows vision+text Ollama slots, (2) YURI jeffrey-local lane in models.json, (3) dual-model pattern vision+command, (4) one-model-at-a-time VRAM rule for 16GB. Output: architecture diagram in prose + file list to ship on rene branch.

Spec Windows setup script: install Ollama, pull models, configure Clicky .env (OLLAMA_VISION_MODEL, OLLAMA_TEXT_MODEL), run YURI ai reindex + fix-main-module-guard --check, smoke test jeffrey-local. Output: ordered command checklist for Rene.

Write operator guide sections: What is Jeffrey, first 30 minutes on Windows, model swap (instruct vs thinking), Clicky tray setup, when to use YURI search vs Jeffrey vision. Plain language for Rene (non-developer friendly).

Attack the Jeffrey plan: VRAM OOM risks, Clicky vision model compatibility, Fable 31B on 16GB claims, Windows native vs WSL paths, tool-loop failures on small models. Output: risk table + mitigations.
